comment:
**Verified by source inspection:** `e20b54c9` resolves the startup subscription mechanism in the [earlier finding](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12603#issuecomment-5759289858). The idle monitor now waits for both configuration files to finish loading or fail, then receives the effective timeout at creation.

```text
Earlier revision: create monitor at 150s -> load custom timeout -> replace notification
Current revision: wait for configuration -> create monitor at the settled timeout
```

Later timeout changes disable the subscription before writing the new timeout, then re-enable it. Stay-awake remains an action gate rather than a subscription gate. No new production issue was identified in this scoped source review.

This resolves the specific early-subscription finding, not a claim of runtime validation across compositors.
